closest_local_terminal_neighbors.title: Decision-Switch Transition Admission
closest_local_terminal_neighbors.boundary: F-1 selects which real environment transitions deserve persistent world-model updates based on counterfactual downstream decision switches. STRATEGY-REOPEN-C01 does not select training transitions or update a world model; it conditions on already-recognized strategy-disconfirming evidence and tests whether exposing the high-level strategy as a decision variable changes the next strategy-family decision.

closest_local_terminal_neighbors.title: Post-Update Decision-Context Validity
closest_local_terminal_neighbors.boundary: PF-9 is a protocol-validity question about whether an updated policy revisits the same decision context and realizes an intended correction. The candidate holds a frozen pre-decision prefix fixed and varies only the reconsideration surface; no persistent update is the treatment.

closest_local_terminal_neighbors.title: Self-Correction Collapse Detector
closest_local_terminal_neighbors.boundary: The stopped C-4 object audits whether answer-level correction behavior collapses into answer changing or reward/format gaming. The candidate is not an answer-correction detector and measures source-defined high-level post-training strategy-family changes.

closest_local_terminal_neighbors.title: Intervention-Validated Self-Correction
closest_local_terminal_neighbors.boundary: The stopped C-5 object validates critique/correction signals before persistence using causal probes. The candidate neither validates a correction for storage nor performs a persistent update; recognition qualification is an independent read-only fork defining the estimand population.

closest_local_terminal_neighbors.title: Counterfactual Evolution Decision Controller
closest_local_terminal_neighbors.boundary: A-7 was a learned four-action evolution controller reproduced by a shallow rule. The candidate has no learned controller claim; its strongest reducers explicitly include generic reflection, scheduled/progress triggers, and a matched local-decision placebo.

full_memory_decision.warning: This audit grants no novelty, ProblemGate, ResearchItem, provider-call, GPU, or experiment authority. A later change to canonical closed-memory or terminal-stop identity invalidates this receipt until re-audited.
